title: Almaty Explorer with Kok Tobe and Lake Issyk
alt: Almaty seen from the top of Kok Tobe hill with the mountains behind
transport: Private airport transfers and private day tours

stops.name: Almaty
stops.accom: 5 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Landmark Soviet era tower on Dostyk Avenue

activities.name: Almaty city sightseeing tour
activities.description: A private tour of the old capital, taking in the Monument of Independence, Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral.

activities.name: Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort
activities.match: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort
activities.description: A day up the Malaya Almatinka valley to the Olympic skating rink at Medeu, then by gondola to the Shymbulak slopes.

activities.name: Green Bazaar and the Rakhat chocolate factory
activities.match: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty
activities.description: The spice and dried fruit halls of the Green Bazaar, then the Rakhat factory whose chocolate every Kazakh family grew up on.

activities.name: Kok Tobe hill and the gondola
activities.match: Day Trip to Kok Tobe from Almaty
activities.description: The cable car up Kok Tobe for the whole city laid out below the mountains, with the Alley of Lovers at the top.

activities.name: Lake Issyk day tour
activities.match: Issyk Lake Day Tour From Almaty
activities.description: A private day east to the turquoise water of Lake Issyk, with the Saka burial mounds and the small site museum nearby.

program.name: Almaty
program.description: Five nights in the old capital with the Shymbulak gondola, the Green Bazaar, the Kok Tobe cable car and a day at Lake Issyk.

day_titles.4: Green Bazaar, chocolate and Kok Tobe

1: Arrival at Almaty International and transfer to your hotel
Check in and the rest of the day free
Optional: the Palace of the Republic and Abai Square
Optional: the stalls of the Zelyony bazaar
2: Breakfast, then a private tour of the city
The Monument of Independence on Republic Square
Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral
3: Breakfast, then up the Malaya Almatinka valley
The Medeu dam and its Olympic skating rink
On by gondola to the Shymbulak ski resort
Snow peaks of the Zailiysky Alatau above you
4: Breakfast, then into the Green Bazaar halls
Horse meat counters, dried fruit and spice stalls
The Rakhat chocolate factory and its shop
Up the Kok Tobe cable car for the city at dusk
5: Breakfast, then east towards the Issyk gorge
The turquoise water of Lake Issyk
The Saka burial mounds and the site museum
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: This is the version most couples pick. One more night than the short break, and you add the cable car and the lake.
expert.tip: Ride Kok Tobe about an hour before sunset. You get the city in daylight on the way up and in lights on the way down.

summary: Six days in Almaty with daily breakfast: a private city tour, the Medeu rink and Shymbulak gondola, the Green Bazaar and Rakhat factory, the Kok Tobe cable car and a day out at Lake Issyk.
included: Included: 5 nights in Almaty with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; private Almaty city sightseeing tour; day trip to the Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort; Green Bazaar and Rakhat chocolate factory trip; Kok Tobe day trip; Lake Issyk day tour; local guide; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Kazakhstan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
